name: web text decoder stream
source: import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer'; import { TextDecoderStream } from 'node:stream/web'; async function main(): Promise<void> { const stream = new TextDecoderStream(); const writer = stream.writable.getWriter(); const reader = stream.readable.getReader(); const pending = reader.read(); await writer.write(Buffer.from([72, 105])); const result = await pending; await writer.close(); console.log(result.value, result.done); }
